correction-deletion: issue original receipt and capture client copy
stale-correction: second client writes C using its original observation
two-writers: submit correction B and correction C without awaiting either
record each native result and final persisted state
stale-delete: second client deletes using its original observation
restore-identical: read target A and issue receipt
attempt delayed write C with original precondition

expectations.ordinaryCorrection: Direct reads and fresh search return the corrected source under the original key. The unrelated source survives.
expectations.ordinaryDeletion: Direct reads no longer find the deleted key, fresh search excludes it, and the unrelated source survives.
expectations.issuedReceipt: After its source changes or disappears, an old Lite receipt should disclose no text when hydrated or recompressed, including its unchanged neighbor. An independent receipt for the neighbor remains usable.
expectations.staleClients: Report whether each native operation accepts or rejects the delayed client. Do not supply application-side conflict resolution.
expectations.restoreIdentical: Record both old receipt validity and the delayed write after identical bytes are restored. A content commitment and a monotonic revision can differ here.
